tasks.description: Move the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference to the specified reachable 3-D target and stop.
Trace a small square in Cartesian space with the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference and return to start.

Visit the specified ordered Cartesian waypoints with the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference.
